title: [maintainer] refactor(app-shell): move Studio's package switcher out of StudioDesignSurface.tsx (slice 2)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBCE4YXYCrA6G1yrthEDVvNJ)_

Refs #29988

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:把 Studio 顶栏的「套件切换器」(套件列表、新建套件、套件详情、套件被删后的跳转)及它与主界面共用的两个常量(663 行)原样搬进同目录新文件 `PackageSwitcher.tsx`,主文件 11,884 → 11,205 行;顺带把 QA 清单里两处还指着旧文件的出处改指新文件。
- 为什么改:#29988 按裁定 #24586 A 逐片只搬不改,把这个文件拆到 1 万行以下;这是第 2 片(接缝表第 2 行),第 1 片是 #30002。
- 风险与回滚:无行为变化,搬走的两段代码逐字节一致,只多了 import 和三个 `export`;对外类型声明 700 个文件逐字节不变;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 的 import 段;`PackageSwitcher.tsx` 的 import 段与三个 `export`;`studio-authoring.json` 两处出处改动与新加的 history 行。
- 两分钟验证:在本分支跑下方「Verification」里的两条 `cmp` 命令,预期都无任何输出(逐字节相同)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## Seam table

Carried forward from #30002. Base lines below are at `origin/main` `f7aab8958` (this PR's base, after slice 1), where `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` is 11,884 lines. "Left" is the file's line count after that row and every row above it: rows 1–2 are measured, the rest are estimates (lines removed, plus about two import lines per slice). Every seam is module-scope; no seam closes over another component's state.

Unchanged from #30002: nothing below the whole-component level of rows 7–11 moves without a logic change, and none of it is needed, because rows 3–6 bring the file under 10,000. Serial order: rows 3–6 in any order, then rows 7–10 only after row 5.

## What changes

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/PackageSwitcher.tsx` (new): row 2, base lines 832–846 and 897–1544, each byte for byte, under a copyright line, a module comment and the imports the two blocks read. The block-level edits are `export` on `const PACKAGE_LIST_TOAST_ID`, `const STUDIO_LANDING_PATH` and `function PackageSwitcher(`, which the surface (all three) and `DataPillar` (the toast id) import back. The first block starts with the switcher's own doc comment, which at base sat stranded above the toast id's doc comment; it moved with that block unchanged.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`: both blocks are gone. It imports the three names from the new module beside the slice 1 import, and drops the import bindings only the switcher used (`AppMark`, `STUDIO_PKG_READONLY_WORD`, `Popover` / `PopoverTrigger` / `PopoverContent`, `AlertTriangle`, `Boxes`, `Building2`, `Settings`, `useHomePath`, `CreatePackageDialog` / `PackageDetailSheet` / `InstalledPackageRow`, `foldCustomizationPairs`); `AppMarkApp` stays as `import type`. Nothing was exported before, so there is no re-export.
- By-path readers (ruling 6597555122 item 3):
  - `ui/packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/homeRecoveryRedirectsFollowDeclaration-7373.test.ts`: the Studio site's `alsoReads` gains `PackageSwitcher.tsx`. Its needle `const homePath = useHomePath()` moved with the switcher, so the site now holds only through this entry (ablation B1).
  - `ui/scripts/__tests__/spec-symbol-ledger-app-shell-7265.test.ts`: `SITES` gains `PackageSwitcher.tsx`.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json`, source re-points only, each with a revision bump and a history row (the area's convention; "No clause changed"):
  - `studio-authoring.app-and-nav-properties` r5 → r6: `source[2]` now cites `StudioNavItemInspector.tsx (the Studio menu-entry inspector)`, the slice 1 follow-up.
  - `studio-authoring.first-run-loop` r11 → r12: `acceptance[0].verify` named `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` as where the `studio-pkg-chip` testid is declared; that testid moved with the switcher, so it now names `PackageSwitcher.tsx`. The clause text is unchanged.
- `.changeset/29988-studio-package-switcher-module.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch, "internal: move-only".

## Tests

No behaviour changes, so no new behaviour test. The existing suites run unchanged; results are in Verification.

## Acceptance notes

- **Readers re-grepped.** `git grep` of `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` / `studio-design/StudioDesignSurface` over `scripts/**`, `ui/scripts/**` and every ui test file finds the same three by-path readers as slice 1. The two whole-text scanners gained the new module (above). `clickableNonControlCensus-13461` walks the tree itself, keys rows by file and handler, and none of its rows is a switcher handler, so it needs no edit. No gate under `scripts/**` names the file.
- **Checklist rows re-read.** Every `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` citation under `docs/qa/` was read against the moved block: only the `studio-pkg-chip` declaration moved. The others cite the pillars, the publish flow and `pkgWritable`, which stay.
- **Two test comments now name the old file for moved text** and are left as they are (prose in test files, outside this slice's file surface): `PackagesPage.confirmFlows-11784.test.tsx` ("`PackageSwitcher`'s eviction in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`") and `packages-io.inflightShare-11797.test.tsx` ("the `PACKAGE_LIST_TOAST_ID` doc in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`"). The seat can re-point them with the next touch of either file.
- **Serial check.** No open PR touched `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, either extended reader or `studio-authoring.json` when the seat claimed (02:34Z) or right before this push (see Verification). The branch was restarted from `origin/main` after #30002 merged and is rebased on `f19fbb8f`; nothing after `f7aab8958` touches `ui/` or `docs/qa/`.
